name: Aishiteru no Strawberry Breeze
source:
High school student Loki is good at classes and is a great friend.  But unknown to everyone, he is haunted by dreams of a mysterious shadowed person chasing and hitting him in the face with a hammer.  When a strange but handsome new student transfers to Sakuramochi High, his dreams start becoming more clear - but his life, more dangerous.

[From [URL=http://detectivedeathmachine.tumblr.com/post/26411879433]official site[/URL]]
translation:
高中生洛基擅长学习，也是个很棒的朋友。然而，没人知道，他一直被一个神秘的、笼罩在阴影中的人纠缠。梦里，那个人追赶他，并用锤子砸他的脸。

当一个奇怪却英俊的新生转入樱饼高中后，他的梦开始变得更加清晰，但生活也变得更加危险。

[来自 [URL=http://detectivedeathmachine.tumblr.com/post/26411879433]官方网站[/URL]]
